method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Slot, List and Draft List
themes.description: Slot and List welded; status is a code enum; cover is an unresolved request marker. Catalogue wants free-by-default Slots, separate Draft List, editable status master, List shown in place of status, and no-acceptance anaesthetist moves to office or colleague. Structural keystone for schedule work. XL.

themes.title: Contract replaces the billing route
themes.description: Procedure.billingRoute, guardian override and insurerId are the retired model. Contract must carry category, scope, aaCode, versions and payment setting, define the billable party, and be picked once per Procedure. OQ-78 open. XL.

themes.title: Procedure master, base units on Contracts, default modifiers
themes.description: No procedure master; base units on RvgCode; range clamps and blocks; modifiers absorbed. Needs procedure master, default RVG Contracts, free out-of-range entry with office warning, pre-filled default modifiers. OQ-88 first. XL.

themes.title: Pricing rule changes
themes.description: Hourly rate x time becomes Contract unit rate (OQ-89); modifier split above 4 units; anaesthetist adjustment gated by Contract; fee-schedule lines; tiers as data. L.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices, credit and rebill
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by an Event on the Procedure with invoice tick and review step; admin additional invoice; credit in full then rebill; negative payable netted in payment run. One build. XL.

themes.title: Prepayment re-founded
themes.description: Trigger from anaesthetist prepaid RVG set; automatic all-or-nothing estimate with contingency and estimated duration; trust hold, refund on cancel, payable repoint on move; overpay no longer fails the Booking. XL.

themes.title: Money model: AA fee, payables, ledger, GST, Xero
themes.description: 5% netted fee becomes a monthly fee invoice (OQ-60); ACCPAY equals receivable; ledger evolution and AUTHORISED snapshot; ageing removed; GST on disbursed payables; patient name out of Xero contacts. L.

themes.title: Intake becomes an admin matching screen
themes.description: Hospital rows must stage in an Admin queue with match/create/create-Draft/reject; nothing applies silently; explicit Save, change sets, update email and templates. HL7/FHIR monitor, PDF ingest and automated changes are Future. XL.

themes.title: Warnings, notifications and admin oversight
themes.description: Wire the existing 15a warning routine into to-do list, Day grid and Booking rows; add rules; shared notification pool; ledger and patient balance views; NHI problem list. L.

themes.title: Surgeon, rooms, blacklist and master-data editing
themes.description: Rooms, surgeon profiles, blacklist, hospital contact emails, spreadsheet loader, master holiday calendar, PWA sign-in. Unlocks update email and blacklist warnings. L.

themes.title: Removals and hide-from-demo
themes.description: Copy Booking, photo capture, Surgeon PDF tab, dashboard Productivity/Leave panels, ACC review flag, stale open-question copy. S to M.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
Verifier corrections: EP-01 and FT-01.2 regraded Partial to Contradicts (own body rules wrong: new Slots not all free, status a code enum, List not shown in place of status); US-01.4.3 Partial to Contradicts (cover request is an acceptance model, 'notified when they respond', vs no-acceptance push); US-01.4.2 Matches to Partial (admin roster static, finders list booked Slots as Free). All other grades upheld.

Structural: (1) Draft List is the keystone. List.anaesthetistId is mandatory and many selectors assume one List per anaesthetist+date+session (listForSlot, DayGrid, Reassign absorb/regenerate, DemoData twoPerDayOk). Safest plan: a separate DraftList entity (own id, hospital/surgeon/day/session, Bookings attach by listId) held outside the canvas; 'assign' converts it into the target's Free List using the existing absorb mechanics. Needs PERSIST_VERSION bump and seeded Draft Lists. All four Draft triggers (office create, anaesthetist move-to-office/return, recurring clash, integration reschedule clash) feed it; integrationActions currently parks clashes as manualIntervention. (2) Name collision: approval ListState 'DRAFT' is printed in the admin ListDrawer header and mobile To-Do; relabel or style Draft Lists distinctly. (3) Slot status is a hardcoded enum (ListStatusKey, theme/statusColours, parity test) and masters.listStatuses is read by nothing but its view-only table; making it master data touches theme, StatusChip/Legend, three apps' cells, permanent-list sheet and the generator. (4) Slot and List are one record; fine (word 'slot' not shown), but 'a List shows in place of the status' needs one shared display helper used by all apps (admin has displayStatusKeyForList; mobile/web finders, Forward Lists and WeekStrip do not, so phone-booked Lists show Free and are offered as free cover). (5) Generator RNG fill makes non-free Slots on rolled days and for new anaesthetists; add a 'free' fill mode for live generation (keep RNG only for seed realism) and skip Anaesthetist.active=false (flag is never read). (6) Admin DayGrid roster is the static seed ANAESTHETISTS array, so added anaesthetists never appear (also hits US-01.4.2); fix by ordering Object.values(masters.anaesthetists) after the cast. (7) 'Permanent list' should become 'Recurring booking' (labels in MasterData, PermanentListSheet, DemoControlPanel); adding/editing should paint the existing horizon; no delete action exists for templates or holidays. (8) No conflict is ever written at Booking creation or editList time (only generator, addHospitalHoliday, setAvailability), so US-01.5.2 AC1 needs a shared reconcile on those paths. (9) RequestCoverSheet/requestCover (pending marker, 'you will be notified when they respond') should be replaced by the move-to-office / push-into-colleague flow with notification-pool post. Dependencies on other epics: blacklist US-13.6.3 and OQ-43 (US-01.3.5, 01.4.5, 01.6.3), shared notification pool FT-13.8 (US-01.4.3, 01.5.5, 01.4.7), update email US-02.3.3, integration reschedule clash US-02.5.2, one-day dashboard US-13.1.1, prepayment payable pair US-06.5.4/OQ-80 (US-01.4.6), audit US-13.5.2. Open questions touching grades: OQ-81 part 3 (sickness path), OQ-84 (vacated Slot default; prototype office default is Unavailable), OQ-85, OQ-86. Demo script beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S2 Beat 2 phone-advice (lines ~187-200) changes if US-01.2.3/01.3.3 are fixed; S2 Beat 3 reassign with vacated Unavailable (lines ~202-212) changes if the OQ-84 default flips; the mobile 'Block a booked Slot' conflict beat is replaced by a return-to-office/assign prompt (US-01.5.5). Demo triggers to add: 'Stage recurring clash' on Admin Day/Masters, canned 'Reschedule clash' hospital message for Draft List creation, admin Conflicts page. Existing controls already covering: clock Next day/Next morning (roll-forward), Add holiday (hospital conflict flag).

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: Biggest EP-02 change: a new Admin matching screen with a staging queue (and the US-02.1.4 unmatched queue) that every hospital row lands on. integrationActions.ts:161 already marks the direct-apply as 'interim until Phase 33'. Silent auto-apply of matched updates is the Future Work behaviour (US-14.6.2), so the current HL7/FHIR path (badged Future scope) is the wrong reading for first release (US-02.1.3, US-02.1.5 Contradict). Existing Surgeon PDFs tab is the starting analogue; fold it into one match/create/reject decision model. Needs a Draft List concept (US-01.6.1; List currently requires anaesthetistId) and 'create new List in a Slot'. Stage rows in a new store slice; retarget processMessage to stage rows; add matchRow/createOnList/createList/createDraftList/rejectRow actions; keep message log/dead-letter for transport failures; show a change-type label (New/Modification/Reschedule/Cancellation) on staged rows (FT-02.5); bump PERSIST_VERSION. Explicit save (US-02.3.2) must be an office-only mode on the shared BookingDetailBody so mobile/PWA write-through capture is unchanged. Update emails (US-02.3.3/02.3.4) need contact emails on Hospital and Surgeon masters (US-13.4.1, US-13.6.1), editable master views, template master data, a change picker over the audit history (better with save-level change sets from US-02.3.2); cover-change trigger depends on US-01.4.3 and US-13.8.2 (neither exists). OQ-13 and OQ-82 open: build matching screen format-agnostic. FT-02.4, US-02.4.1, US-02.5.5 already match; photo capture (US-02.4.4, Future Work) ships anyway. Cross-epic: Booking/Procedure still carries insurer and billing-route fields while the catalogue moves payer to the Contract (ManualBookingForm); US-02.5.6 concurrent-edit detection and US-08.4.4 reproducibility build on US-02.3.2/02.5.5. Demo-guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 Beat 1 (MSG-STG-1001 lands Sarah Mitchell on Souter 28 Jul AM) needs an admin match step before mobile shows it; S1 Future-scope caveat text changes; S2 amend steps and S5 audit tour change with explicit Save; S4 Beat 4 dead-letter flow changes if rows go to a queue. DemoControlPanel S1/S2 jumps, and registry triggers fire-hospital-message, replay-hospital-message, ingest-pdf-row need updating; add an 'Import hospital bookings' trigger on the matching screen. Verification changes: US-02.3.1 missing list trimmed to NHI, SUBMITTED-list procedure edit, and create-on-booked-List; all other verdicts upheld."

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations:
Structural: FT-03.7 needs a new Event entity (child of Procedure: own date/time, time or fixed fee, invoiced tick, billable party with same-as flag, source anaesthetist or admin). It replaces the post-op addendum (Booking.bookingType 'postOpAddendum', addendumOfBookingId, addPostOpAddendum, 'Add post-op event' button, 'Stage post-op scenario' trigger in shared/demoTriggers/registry.ts:313 and the DemoControlPanel exceptions walk-through; code comment already says Phase 39 replaces it). The four event items (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1/2/3) are one build, not four. Invoice build/billingRun must learn events: line on a pending Procedure invoice vs separate traceable invoice next run, via the same review step. US-03.7.3 also depends on additional invoices and credit notes (US-08.6.x, OQ-72); Invoice.kind has no credit note.

Cross-epic dependencies: US-03.3.1 and US-03.2.3 depend on the master procedure list, default RVG Contracts and procedure-filtered Contract list (US-04.3.1/04.3.2, US-04.4.2, US-05.1.x); base units must move from RvgCode to Contract (unit-range location still open). Cheap partial fix for US-03.3.1 independent of that: unclamp the range stepper, drop the validator range failure and register an out-of-range warning rule in the 15a routine. US-03.5.1 needs a Contract setting for whether anaesthetist adjustment is allowed (US-04.2.2 / US-05.4.1) plus a percent mode on the anaesthetist card. US-03.3.6 depends on the Contract unit rate (US-05.2.6) and open OQ-89; add a line date field regardless; post-care lines may move to events.

Matches with no gap: US-03.1.3 (attachments), US-03.3.4 (ASA seed + itemised modifiers; modifier master gaps such as beach-chair/prone and VM1, TTE etc. are US-05.1.5 master data), US-03.6.2 (incomplete Bookings listing). All three re-checked in code, including the Confirmed one.

Demo-script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S4 Beat 2 post-op addendum (Stage post-op scenario, Add post-op event, new addendum Booking) breaks when addendum is replaced by events. Beats touching RVG code pick or base units (S1 capture, Ellison hip replacement, S3 money beats) change if base units seed from the Contract and range entry is unclamped. Beats showing the Price override card or the rate x time line (Aria hourly contract booking) change with US-03.5.1 and US-03.3.6. S1 List attachment aside is unaffected.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations:
All 14 gradings upheld after re-opening code; only edits were evidence additions, one dropped point (US-04.2.4 per-line effective date) and one size change (US-04.1.1 S to M).

Core structural conflict: EP-04 replaces the billing-route step with Contract-defines-billable-party. The prototype has Procedure.billingRoute, per-Procedure billablePartyId/insurerId, and a Billable-party route that resolves no Contract. The code comment on copyBooking already calls the route 'interim until Phase 20', so the existing plan anticipates this. Closing EP-04, US-04.3.3 and US-04.3.4 properly means reworking Procedure billing context, validateBookingForBilling, invoiceBuild resolution, EditBillingSetupSheet, ManualBookingForm, PhoneAdviceBooking, integrationActions, seed and PERSIST_VERSION (currently 16). It overlaps FT-11.2 and US-11.2.2 (billable party) and OQ-78 (Greg may drop default Contracts), so expect rework risk. OQ-78 recommendation: keep the catalogue model until Greg supplies his design.

Dependencies on other epics: master procedure list (US-05.1.6) gates US-04.2.1 procedure scope, US-04.2.11, the US-04.3.2 procedure filter and US-04.4.2. US-05.2.6, US-05.2.5 and OQ-89 gate US-04.2.2 and US-04.2.4. US-05.4.1 and US-05.4.2 gate anaesthetist adjustment. US-08.2.3 and US-08.6.4 gate US-04.2.12 and US-04.2.11. US-07.2.2 (office review flags) gates US-04.3.7. Also US-12.1.1 and US-06.1.1.

Reuse: ContractEditSheet and the MasterData Contracts view, the protected-default invariant (store/contractActions.ts), the Type 1/2/3 fee engine, ContractPrice matching, FunderAllocationSheet, reviewFlags. Seeded Bookings already carry default hospital Contracts, so US-04.3.3 is partly visible on seed data.

Demo triggers: nothing in this epic is automatic or time-driven, so no new control-panel buttons are needed; all gaps are admin or office UI. Seeds would help presenters: a hospital-sheet procedure not on a Contract schedule (US-04.3.7) and a combination Contract (US-04.2.11).

Demo-guide beats affected: S4 billing-failure beat (~line 334; the trigger end-dates the seed COS ACC Contract, and Resolve and retry relies on contractIneffective); S5 Beat 4 contract effective-dating (~lines 413-422, Health NZ Type 2); S3 money beat (~line 254); S2 phone-advice booking if a Contract field is added. The cheat sheet's 'Three billing routes' table, route glossary and ACC notes (lines 18, 31, 82, 110-111, 174, 305) need rewriting if the route concept goes. The billing-failure trigger and DemoControlPanel S1 to S5 jumps assume seed Contract ids (CT-COS-ACC, CT-HNZ), so any renumbering to AA codes must check those.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: Structural: (1) New procedure master (US-05.1.6, OQ-88) with default RVG Contracts holding base units (US-04.4.2) and Contract base-unit overrides is the biggest change; fee.ts resolveBtm and the RVG pick flow (US-03.3.1) get rewired, so phase it with FT-04.4 and FT-03.3, not alone. Also bumps PERSIST_VERSION and the masters shape; OQ-88 (one list vs two, system code home) should be decided before building. (2) 'Absorbed modifiers' (RvgCode.absorbsModifierCodes, refusal in modifierUnits, struck-through chips, Admin Absorbs column, ProcedureCodeCard text) is replaced by default modifiers pre-filled on a Procedure (US-05.1.4); P1 becomes charged by default on spine/shoulder/hip codes and shifts seeded fees. Interim home for default modifiers can be the RvgCode row until the procedure master lands. (3) Hourly rate x time billing line, permitsIndividualArrangement flag and INDIVIDUAL_ARRANGEMENT_MESSAGE should be reworked into a Contract defined unit rate (US-05.2.6, OQ-89, shared with US-04.2.2 and US-03.3.6). The Type 2 agreedUnitRate path already prices a Contract unit rate and the seeded Aria contract already carries 26.5, so the simplest reading collapses the two; seeded CT-ARIA-HOURLY and rate x time Bookings (seed/bookings.ts:717-740, 875) need rewriting. (4) Modifier split above 4 units (US-05.3.1, OQ-15 open) needs a Booking-level allocation pass: feeFor and procedureFee are per-procedure and called from bookingFee, buildInvoicesForBooking, ReviewScreen, prepayment estimate and web ListDetailView; and the per-procedure share should show in the Booking breakdown (US-05.3.5). (5) RVG master and modifier master are view-only; the RVG master is read from the store but modifier pricing reads the static MODIFIER_CODES table, so any admin add/edit needs the calculator to read the store master. Modifier list should gain VM1, TTE, PACU, EAA, POC, NC per domain-model.md. (6) Time-unit tiers should become data (US-05.2.2) and the stale 'assumption' copy removed (UnitsCard caption, DemoControlPanel callout, timeUnits.ts comment). (7) ACC pre-op (US-05.5.2) depends on events FT-03.7 / US-03.7.1 (not built). Verifier corrections: FT-05.2 size None to S (Partial cannot be size None); US-05.1.1 Partial to Contradicts (base units still priced from the RVG master, Absorbs column). Items 05.2.1, 05.2.5, 05.3.5, 05.4.2 confirmed Matches; minor notes: Type 3 silently falls back to BTM when no schedule row matches (revisit with US-04.2.4/OQ-89). No demo-trigger buttons needed for this epic (all behaviour is user-driven in master data and capture screens). Demo guide impact: S1 Beat 3 (picks 20950 by RVG code, narrates 'Base plus tiered Time plus Modifiers') changes if the picker becomes a procedure master; any beat or screenshot showing hourly rate x time or struck-through positioning becomes stale; S3 invoice figures shift only if default-modifier pre-fill or modifier split changes seeded units.

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations: Verified against code (PERSIST_VERSION is 16). Core mismatch: prototype prepayment is a per-Procedure payment category (selfFundedPrepayment on billableParty route) with full or split-deposit detail, raised manually by office; catalogue is an anaesthetist-level prepaid RVG set, all-or-nothing auto-calculated estimate (contingency units, estimated duration), generated at booking setup, trust-held until procedure done, refunded on cancel, payable repointed on move. Corrections made by verifier: US-06.2.3 Partial to Contradicts (lower-than-estimate final fails the Booking, wrong behaviour), US-06.4.1 Matches to Partial (balance not traceable to the prepayment invoice, line still says deposit). All other grades upheld. No UI or store action sets prepaymentDetail (seed only), so a UI-created Pre-payment Procedure cannot pass completion validation. Prerequisites: US-06.1.1/US-05.1.3 (prepaid set on Anaesthetist profile), US-06.2.5 (estimated duration), US-06.3.6 (letters), US-06.5.1/06.5.2 (trust, refund, via US-08.6.2 credit) gate FT-06.5 and US-06.5.3; US-09.1.3/US-08.3.1 pair semantics for US-06.5.4; US-13.7.x date escalation (Phase 27) for US-06.3.2. Single fix covers FT-06.4, US-06.2.3 and US-06.4.2 (remove negativeTotal for prepaid overpay; update prePaymentInvoice.test.ts:182 and billingRun.test.ts:484 which encode the old rule). Money model gap: no trust-hold state between ACCPAY authorised and disbursed; payables run pays anything authorised and the seed disburses BC0001 on 16 Jul for a 24 Jul procedure. Cancel (lifecycle.ts:348) and move (lifecycle.ts:635) have zero money handling. Demo-guide impact: S4 Beat 1 (Riley Fri 24 AM split $800 on flat $1,200 fee) and Souter Fri 24 PM seeded disbursed prepayment change; InvoiceDocument deposit/balance copy and billing monitor 'fully pre-paid' copy need updating. EP-06 verdict is a roll-up; size overlaps children. Open questions OQ-38, OQ-61, OQ-76, OQ-80 do not block grading.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations: Only US-07.1.1 (Proposed, absorbs retired US-07.1.2) was in scope. Prototype implements it end to end on mobile and web; no change needed. Blocker messages derive from completionBlockersFor and validateBookingForBilling, so changes to US-03.6.1 and US-03.6.2 flow through automatically. Warnings (FT-13.7) are soft and never gate submit. The domain-model phrase 'no confirm step on submit' is ambiguous (it appears in the warnings bullet), but the story's screenshots include a confirm step, so the existing confirm sheet stays. Web has no success overlay after submit, only the header switching to 'Submitted to office', matching the web-submit-list-submitted screenshot. Demo beats S1 and S3 are unaffected.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: All 12 reviewer verdicts upheld after re-opening the code. Late-billing and correction half of EP-08 (FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.6) is almost all new. Needs: (1) an Event element on the Procedure (shared with FT-03.7, OQ-63) plus a standard review step with a next-run invoicing rule; (2) a free-form Additional invoice (Invoice.kind additional, parent link to original Procedure and invoice, free-form line fields, any-party picker); (3) a credit note (Invoice kind credit, credit in full, linked to original), negative payable to the anaesthetist netted in runPayables and shown on remittance, Xero ACCREC credit plus ACCPAY reversal pair (the dormant 'voided' status is the only hook), and delivery of the credit to the billable party; (4) rebill-from-copy. Build order: events and review step, then US-08.6.3, then US-08.6.5/08.6.2, then 08.6.4 and 08.6.6. Retire addPostOpAddendum (Booking.bookingType/addendumOfBookingId, own comment says Phase 39 replaces it); US-08.6.1 screenshots in the catalogue still show the old addendum UI and are stale. US-08.1.1 is the big structural Contradicts: the engine must stop resolving routes and falling back to default Type 1, and a Contract version snapshot must be locked on the Procedure (shared with US-04.3.5, US-04.2.x Contract version/paymentSetting, FT-11.2 billable party from Contract and no per-Booking override per OQ-67, OQ-78 open); the same lock underpins US-08.4.4 reproducibility and US-08.2.3 typed $/% split from Contract. FT-08.2 and US-08.2.1 are satisfied; keep their grouping tests green when billable-party derivation changes under EP-04/EP-11. OQ-77 unresolved (rebill total vs no forced total, whether credit reverses payable, split before invoicing): adopt no forced total, credit reverses the payable, same credit-and-rebill flow, unless AA says otherwise. Demo-guide impact: S4 Beat 2 post-op addendum (about lines 318-327) becomes wrong and needs rewriting around an event or additional invoice; S5 Beat 4 contract effective-dating (about 413-422) is where reproducibility belongs, and the Billing monitor 'Resolve and retry' that clears a contract end date (admin BillingMonitor resolveAndRetry) conflicts with the lock model. Demo controls: reuse 'Stage post-op scenario' to get an invoiced Procedure; add 'Run next billing run' on Billing monitor for queued events; optional 'Regenerate from recipe'. Bump PERSIST_VERSION (currently 16) for new invoice kinds, events and Contract version fields."

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: EP-09 Proposed; 3 stories in scope, only US-09.3.1 is Confirmed. Real defect there: patient/billable-party names go to Xero contact Name and show in the sim (Contacts tab, pair Payer, money-flow cards, seed history.ts). Fix: contact name = hidden ID or neutral label for patient and billableParty types only, update seed contacts, bump PERSIST_VERSION, rewrite the stale NHI callout (OQ-30 answered) and Contacts help text, keep patient name only in the engine-link callout. US-09.1.1: Xero records have no InvoiceNumber/Reference fields (derived at view time); add them to XeroAccRec/XeroAccPay or show them as labelled Xero fields; the ACCPAY '-P' suffix is a reading question. Admin rail showing numbers (not GUIDs) matches the catalogue's own image, so no change there. US-09.2.1 needs nothing. Note a second payment path (DemoXero settleInvoice) bypasses the trigger registry. Out-of-list EP-09 items: FT-09.1 partial-run policy (per-invoice billing state, resumable; multi-pair List partial failure not demonstrated, only single-case handoff fault + Resolve & retry), FT-09.2 poll + webhook sharing one idempotent handler (done), FT-09.3 archiving (in place). EP-09 resilience points (async queue, backoff, void-in-Xero divergence) have no representation. Dependencies: US-08.4.3, US-08.3.1, US-10.2.1, US-15.0.6. Demo-script: S5 tour ends on Xero sim; docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md was not opened.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: All five reviewer verdicts upheld after re-reading the catalogue files and code. The 5% service-fee model is baked across domain (agencyFee.ts, XeroAccPay.serviceFeeRate/Amount/amountPayable), store (xeroHandoff.ts:234, paymentActions pro-rata over net payable, selectors.paymentHistoryFor), seed (billing.ts:204, history.ts:265), Web Payments table ('AA fee', 'Net to you'), Xero sim pair view and Admin invoice. Removing it makes ACCPAY = ACCREC value (BCTI same value as receivable, US-09.1.4/OQ-42), which fixes US-10.2.1 as a side effect; do FT-10.3 fee removal, US-10.2.1 and US-10.3.1/10.3.3 together, and bump PERSIST_VERSION (seed shape change). appSettings (added 15a for warning rules) is a ready home for fee settings (fixed items + per-invoice rate); no fee settings exist yet. US-10.2.5 depends on a credit-after-invoicing/negative-invoice item in EP-08 (US-08.6.2, OQ-71/72) and on BCTI wording; US-10.2.6 and OQ-47 weekly cycle would reshape the single Run payables button into a weekly run with remittance advice (shared with 10.2.5). Fee invoice needs BCTI count per anaesthetist per month, paid-only (OQ-60 Greg view), and a separate fee receivable concept in the Xero sim (separate bank account). OQ-60 and OQ-47 are open, so placeholder amounts and cycle must be labelled assumptions. Demo-guide impact (03-demo-script.md): S3 Beats 2 and 3 (5% fee numbers $152.38/$7.62/$144.76), partial-payment beat and S4 half payment step must be rewritten; add beats for the monthly fee-invoice run and a refund netted in a payment run with remittance advice. Existing demo controls (payment full/half/replay, Run payables, Simulate payment and payout) are retained.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Structural: explicit billingRoute (hospital / billableParty / insurer) with per-Procedure billablePartyId, insurerId and patientPaymentCategory is the model the catalogue retired (OQ-67, OQ-55). FT-11.2, US-11.2.1, US-11.2.2 and US-11.4.2 close together with the Contract-defines-payer rework (catch-up phases on contract model, one contract per procedure, billable party and required inputs); plan once, not per story. OQ-78 (Greg: no default Contract, hospital holds every Contract) is open, so do not hard-code the default-Contract payer prompt beyond the catalogue recommendation. Dependencies: US-11.2.4 and US-11.3.2 need the Phase 15a warnings framework plus a UI that does not exist yet (dashboard to-do list, per-Booking warning display, clear action; EP-13 US-13.7.1/13.7.2) and a minimal admin threshold setting for the 90-day rule. US-11.2.4 also leans on US-11.2.3 (invoice email required, Confirmed, not built; no invoice email field exists anywhere) and the Contract-defined payer for its trigger. US-11.1.4 depends on US-11.1.5 (problem list), OQ-49, and touches authoriseList, ReviewScreen flags and US-07.3.1; attaching an NHI later also needs a patient edit field and duplicate handling. Seed changes: child as patient-direct payer, patient with unpaid invoice older than 90 days, patient with credit balance, patient without NHI on a List to authorise; PERSIST_VERSION bump. No standalone patient master or record screen exists though story screenshots for US-11.1.1 and US-11.3.1 imply one; consider a small admin patient view. US-11.1.1 is the only real Matches and the dedupe beat (S1 MSG-STG-1001, Sarah Mitchell) stays valid. epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: EP-12 and FT-12.1 are Grouping; FT-12.2 is Contradicts only through its children (size S is roll-up glue, do not double count). Real gaps: (1) US-12.2.1 (Confirmed) flat list is contradicted by age chips, bucket columns, Overdue tab/route and the dashboard Receivables aging panel (OQ-59 answered, D8, Phase 38). Removing ageing also touches US-12.2.3 (dashboard panel, receivablesAgingFor) and US-08.3.5. Open ambiguity: whether 'unpaid payable' means unpaid by the payer (current: invoice total minus received) or not yet disbursed to the anaesthetist (US-10.1.2); today a row disappears when the payer pays and shows the gross invoice, not the net payable. (2) US-12.2.2 GST schedule is receipts-based and rolling; needs payout-date cash basis, a balance check against what was paid, and period-aligned windows; depends on US-10.1.2, US-05.2.7, and the AA fee treatment (OQ-60). (3) US-12.1.4 bank details wholly missing from type, seed, forms, table, audit labels and the payables run; HPI should be 'HPI CPN' and editable. Adding fields needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). (4) US-12.1.2: no anaesthetist profile or settings screen anywhere (mobile More tab is static); catalogue text says the anaesthetist sets it but the captions say the office; mobile peek ignores the period; label drift Bi-monthly vs Two-monthly and raw 'biMonthly' in the Master data table. Demo-guide impact: 03-demo-script.md:57,273 (/web/accounts/overdue, 'remain under Overdue') and 01-personas-and-responsibilities.md:114 ('receivables aging'); GST beat becomes payout-based. Tests to update: AccountsScreen.test.tsx and aging selector tests. The phase plan docs (phase-26, phase-38) already anticipate all four gaps. Out of this assignment but adjacent: US-12.1.1, US-12.1.3, US-12.2.3.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: Verification outcome: 26 of 27 gradings upheld; one correction (US-13.2.1 Missing to Partial, because the Billing monitor already shows a whole-ledger payables-due figure). Structural needs: new domain entities (SurgeonRoom, blacklist entries, notification, ledger view model), a Surgeon profile route, a Ledger screen, a notification pool panel, a spreadsheet loader on Master data, and a PWA sign-in screen. Phase 15a built the warning plumbing (domain/warnings routine; store openWarnings, clearWarning, warningSummaryByList) but no UI consumes it and the rule registry holds only prepaymentUnpaid. Wire it into the admin RightRail (to-do list with Clear), the DayGrid outline (replace the direct prepayment '$' flag), and Booking rows in mobile/web lists, rather than rebuilding. A 'Stage sample warnings' demo button is needed because the other three rules depend on EP-11 patient balance and child payer and US-03.3.1 base-unit range data. Two parallel flag mechanisms exist (reviewFlags.ts on the Review screen versus the warning routine); US-13.7.1 says one routine, so fold them together or keep review notes deliberately separate. Dependencies: US-13.8.2 needs US-01.4.3 (anaesthetist moves own List), FT-01.6 Draft Lists (also US-13.1.1 unassigned Drafts) and US-02.3.3 update email; US-13.6.3 needs US-13.6.2 profile, US-01.3.5 and US-01.4.5; US-13.6.1 rooms feed US-02.3.3 To address, US-11.1.5 and US-06.2.5; US-13.2.2 depends on the EP-11 patient profile; US-13.5.2 credit notes depend on US-08.6.2. Open questions OQ-43, OQ-79, OQ-83 and OQ-85 leave blacklist visibility, pool expiry and actioned state, sign-in platform and single-Booking move undecided; build the simple recommendations. Demo guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S2 beat 1 read-the-day and beat 3 reassign change if the grid shows booking counts or unassigned Drafts; S4 beat 1 prepayment warning (Souter Fri 24 Jul, Annette Riley) gains the to-do entry and Booking-row triangle; S5 audit and 'Simulate sign-in attempts' change if a real sign-in screen lands; S3 billing monitor beats change with the sort/filter/group restyle. Note for owner: SubmitListSheet's generic submit confirmation is not warning-related and was read as compatible with the 'no confirm step' criterion in US-13.7.3.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: Both items Partial, concentrated in shared ManualCardForm (src/shared/flows) so one change lands in web, mobile/PWA and admin phone-advice. Nothing contradicts the catalogue. Dependencies: US-11.1.1 (full NZHIS L4), US-11.1.2 (dual-format NHI), US-11.1.4/5 and OQ-49 (missing NHI, problem list, duplicates), US-12.1.4 (HPI CPN labelling, bank details). Cheap win: relabel 'HPI id' to 'HPI CPN' (fieldLabels.ts:121, AddAnaesthetistFlow:72, EditAnaesthetistSheet:61), no seed change. Demo guide: S2 phone-advice lookup beat (~03-demo-script.md:181) and NHI validator beat (~378-383) remain valid; making lookup fail on invalid NHI or NHI required would alter them. PERSIST_VERSION bump only if seed changes (extra canned patients are code-only).

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: Only US-15.0.1 in scope (status Proposed, no open questions). Closing it takes two pieces of work. (1) Role-aware capture context: hide contract name, route chip and 'FIXED CONTRACT PRICE' from the anaesthetist but keep them for office. This overlaps the billing and contract epics, so check there first. (2) A small shared in-context help component (e.g. a '?' popover in src/shared/ui) used on mobile capture, admin Day view and admin Review. Neither touches the persisted store shape, so no PERSIST_VERSION bump. Demo-guide beats are unaffected, though any beat that shows the contract line on mobile would change. Training and docs are presenter-narrated.

items.requirement_says: On a Booking with a prepaid-set Procedure and a person-payer, the engine auto-generates the prepayment invoice at booking setup; not sent until an admin approves, then goes with a letter; creates linked receivable and payable and the Xero draft pair; List submit does not invoice again.
items.prototype_does: Office-only 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' button in the pre-payment banner (status required) -> raisePreProcedureInvoice builds Invoice kind prePayment + BillingCase, then handoffCasesForBooking creates ACCREC (awaitingPayment) + ACCPAY (draft) immediately. Idempotent. Refused once List AUTHORISED/billed. Balance run nets prepaid so it is not invoiced again. Emailing is a separate manual 'Email invoice' action.
missing_or_wrong: No automatic generation at setup (manual raise button only)
No pending-approval state; raised = live ACCREC in awaitingPayment, not a draft receivable
No prepayment letter

Raise refused when List AUTHORISED (probably fine)

Day flag only for the selected day, no upcoming-Bookings list

items.summary: Requirement flag is derived live, so editing the payment category clears the banner, but the stale prepayment invoice/pair stays, the amount is never re-checked after raising, and a move does no prepayment handling. OQ-70/OQ-80 apply.

items.summary: After AUTHORISED the billing run deducts the prepaid amount already invoiced and invoices a positive remainder as a standard invoice. But the balance is not explicitly traceable to the prepayment invoice (no invoice number or link), and the deduction line is still worded 'deposit'.

items.prototype_does: authoriseList emits listAuthorised, runBillingForList threads prePaidByProcedure, invoiceBuild adds a procedure-linked negative 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line on the same counterparty, $0 raises none, positive raises the balance (kind standard). Refuses to net if payer changed or a funder split is present. Balance invoice note: 'This procedure was pre-paid; this invoice covers any remaining balance.'

No credit-note kind on Invoice (kind is standard|prePayment only)

Nothing links the two Bookings or shows the two estimates

Payable to B for the prepaid amount not demonstrable

items.summary: Admin Review screen lets the office check route, Contract, code, times and flags per Booking and correct billing setup before Authorise (approval at SUBMITTED, per OQ-26). Missing: under-18 billable-party warning, invoice email and address review, insurer details and every Procedure's Contract on the review row, and an explicit Contract approval step.
items.requirement_says: At SUBMITTED review the admin checks each Booking's Procedures, the Contract selected for each, whether an insurer's Contract is needed and the insurer details, references, addresses, invoice emails, and anything missed or wrong. The admin approves or corrects the Contract selections, and gets a mild non-blocking warning for a patient under 18 who is the billable party (US-11.2.4).
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen shows a row per non-cancelled card (Time, Patient, Route, Contract, Code, Times, B/T/M, Units, Fee, Flags). The Contract column is the first procedure's governing Contract only, and Route shows 'Mixed' when procedures differ. Flags are not-completed, pre-payment outstanding or overridden, no billing reference, ACC billed to patient, and manual B/T/M override. The office can open a card on a SUBMITTED List and use OfficeBillingSetup to edit route, insurer, category, guardian payer, Contract, reference, price override and funder split. Log phone note exists. 'Authorise for billing' is the only approval and is not gated by flags. Review happens after submit, as OQ-26 says.
missing_or_wrong: No under-18 check anywhere: ageYears exists in shared/format.ts and is only displayed on card detail. No flag, warning or to-do when a patient under 18 is the billable party, and nothing distinguishes a hospital billable party (US-11.2.4 ACs: raised, not raised for a hospital, clearable by admin).
No invoice email on any entity: grep for invoiceEmail and 'invoice email' in non-test, non-seed src finds nothing. The review screen also shows no billable-party or patient address or email.

Insurer details are not on the review table. Insurer is held on the Procedure (procedure.insurerId, shown only inside OfficeBillingSetup), whereas OQ-55 says neither Patient nor Booking holds it and each Procedure's Contract says who pays.
Contract column shows only the first Procedure's Contract (ReviewScreen primaryView), so a Booking whose Procedures sit on different Contracts cannot be reviewed at a glance.
No explicit 'approve Contract selections' action or per-Booking approved marker. Approval is implicit in Authorise.

Review is framed by billing Route (hospital / billable party / insurer), while domain-model says there is no separate route step and the Contract defines the billable party. The guardian is a separate BillableParty entity (billablePartyActions), whereas US-11.2.4 says there is no separate guardian record. Both belong to EP-04/EP-11 but shape this screen.
No dashboard to-do or warning model for the under-18 warning to appear in or be cleared from. It is built elsewhere (US-11.2.4, US-13.7.2) and surfaced here.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/reviewFlags.ts:59-118 (flag kinds a to e only, no age check)
aa-prototype/src/shared/card/OfficeBillingSetup.tsx:51-80 (insurer on procedure, Route rows, guardian payer)
searched: under 18|under18|minor|invoiceEmail|invoice email in src (non-test, non-seed) -> only guardian comments, ageYears display, no invoice email field
items.demo_trigger: Seed a patient under 18 who is their own billable party on a SUBMITTED List in the Review queue. The review row shows a mild 'Patient under 18 is the billable party' pill and the same warning appears in the dashboard to-do (once built), where it can be cleared. No new button needed. The row also needs a hospital-billable minor on another List to show the no-warning case.
items.verify_note: Re-opened ReviewScreen, reviewFlags and OfficeBillingSetup and re-grepped for age and invoice-email logic: reviewer's points hold. Kept Partial rather than Contradicts: the story's own screenshots caption the review as 'route, Contract, codes and flags' and the office-setup edit as 'choosing the route and Contract', so route-based display is tolerated at story level. The route and guardian-entity model divergence is recorded as a note and belongs to EP-04 and EP-11. Added the missing dashboard to-do dependency and the guardian-entity point. Size M kept: flag plus invoice email field and column plus per-Procedure Contract display, with the warning routine itself in US-11.2.4.
items.title: Office review of Contracts and references

items.prototype_does: authoriseList (SUBMITTED only, office only, audited) emits listAuthorised; runBillingForList processes the whole List atomically with per-card isolation and stamps billedAtISO. Confirm overlay, then 'List authorised · locked for billing' banner with invoice count; rows lock. Procedure holds only governingContractId (live reference, no version); invoice lines snapshot rate detail into descriptions at run time, and the run is synchronous so effective freeze is at authorise.

Owned jointly with US-04.3.5 (Confirmed): plan the snapshot once, there
evidence: searched: snapshot in src -> only invoiceBuild comments and DemoControlPanel tour text
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo Control Panel compliance tour (end-date the Health NZ Contract after authorising, reopen the invoice to show it is unchanged) already shows invoice-level freeze; extend it to show the locked Procedure still names the original Contract version once snapshotting exists.
items.verify_note: Confirmed no version field on Contract or Procedure and that authoriseList only flips state. Authorise mechanics and whole-List hand-off verified. Filled the reviewer's empty demo_trigger with the existing compliance tour. Partial is right: nothing wrong, the versioned lock is missing (mostly US-04.3.5's build).
items.title: Authorise the List

items.summary: Every Booking and Procedure write path goes through editRefusal, which rejects all actors once a List is AUTHORISED. Admin shows locks and the Data Inspector guard console demonstrates the refusal.
items.requirement_says: The system rejects any attempt to edit an AUTHORISED List's Bookings or Procedures so the record handed to the Billing/Invoice Engine never changes.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal returns 'listAuthorised' first, for anaesthetist, office and integration alike. It gates editCard, editProcedure, editList, createCard, copyCard, addProcedure, removeProcedure, cancelCard, complete and uncomplete, intake/patient edits and the billing-line and funder-allocation actions. reassignList and reassignCard refuse an AUTHORISED source or target. items.requirement_says: Dedicated Xero org under the engine (not system of record) mirrors an ACCREC and draft ACCPAY per ledger pair, detects payment by webhook plus daily poll, uses hidden-ID contacts. Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.
items.prototype_does: Handoff is synchronous inside one mutate after the billing run. A single armed fault (settings.failNextHandoff) records handoffFailure on the case, shown in Billing Monitor with a manual 'Resolve & retry'. Webhook and poll are simulated. No alerting of persistent handoff failure beyond the Billing Monitor chip
No divergence handling: an invoice voided/amended directly in Xero is never detected; no payment-against-credited-invoice ordering case
'voided' ACCREC status exists in types/UI but is never driven
Epic frames the engine ledger as system of record (US-08.3.2); prototype has no internal ledger, BillingCase + XeroAccRec/AccPay hold the money (dependency on EP-08)

Web Accounts tab named 'Overdue' (route /web/accounts/overdue): one row per invoice but amount placed in Current / 31 to 60 / 61 to 90 / 90+ columns, per-bucket footer totals, helper copy 'ordered by date raised'. Dashboard 'Receivables aging' panel with bars and '(N) accounts over 60 days, view overdue accounts' link. Rows oldest first, billing-mirror sourced, next-day visibility.
missing_or_wrong: Age chips on every mobile row (AgeChip, amber >60d) must go
Web table ageing bucket columns and per-bucket footer totals must become one amount column and a plain total

'Overdue' tab, route, and copy ('/web/accounts/overdue', 'accounts over 60 days', 'view overdue accounts', screen docstring) must become Outstanding; Overdue has no basis since invoices have no due date
receivablesAgingFor bucketing and the dashboard 'Receivables aging' panel contradict no-ageing (panel itself owned by US-12.2.3/US-08.3.5)

Row semantics: outstanding = invoice.total (gross receivable incl. GST) minus receivedAmount from the payer, so the row vanishes once the payer pays even though the payable to the anaesthetist is not yet disbursed, and the amount is the gross invoice not the payable net of AA fee; requirement says unpaid payables. Ambiguous, confirm with AA (US-10.1.2 two payment states)

items.summary: A GST schedule exists but is built on amounts received from payers into AA (gross + GST), not on payables actually paid to the anaesthetist; it has no balance check and uses a rolling, unsaved-toggle window.
items.requirement_says: Per-anaesthetist GST-return schedule aligned to their GST period: sales AA made for them, GST component of each, and a check that it balances with what they were paid. Cash basis: list only payables AA actually paid them in the period; outstanding falls into a later period.
items.prototype_does: Web Accounts 'GST activity' and mobile 'GST this month' list billing.receipts (payments received from payers) in a date window, each with gross and GST (gross*0.15/1.15), plus period totals. Reads the billing ledger not Xero. Image captions in the catalogue describe the same 'Amounts received' screens.
missing_or_wrong: Basis is wrong: rows are receipts into AA (date received), not payables paid out (disbursement date); an invoice paid in by the customer but not yet disbursed already counts in the period
No 'sales made for them' view (invoice ex-GST amounts) and no balance check or reconciliation against what was actually paid to them (net of AA fee / disbursed amount)
GST derived from the gross receipt, not from the paid-out payable portion (partial payments and payouts)
Period is a rolling N months to today, not the anaesthetist's aligned period; mobile hardcoded to current month; web period toggle unsaved

Disbursement records with atISO exist (state.xero.disbursements / Disbursement type) but the report never reads them; any switch must stay on the billing mirror, not Xero (add disbursement dates to BillingCase/ledger if absent)
Outstanding falling into a later period is not demonstrated
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo Xero 'Simulate payment and payout' / 'Pay <anaesthetist> now' and Control Panel 'Run payables' / 'Record payment' move money in and out; the schedule should react on the payout date (receipt alone should not add a row). Optionally add a 'Reconciles to payouts' tick on the GST activity screen.
items.verify_note: Read gstActivityFor: filters receipts by receipt date only, no disbursement involvement, no balance check. Confidence medium (not high) only because catalogue image captions still read 'Amounts received', but the body text ('actually paid them') is explicit. Added the ledger-vs-Xero constraint for any fix and the later-period carryover.

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is a sound July-2026 build of the original RFP, but the catalogue has moved well past it. Of roughly 190 graded items, about 40 Match (mostly mobile/web capture, audit, billing-monitor and the per-counterparty invoice grouping), about 70 are Partial, about 40 Contradict and about 35 are Missing. Seven epics (EP-01, EP-04, EP-06, EP-08 late billing, EP-10 fee, EP-11, EP-02 intake) are Contradicts or XL at epic level. The gap is mostly structural, not cosmetic. Four model rewrites carry most of it: Slot/List/Draft List (DM-02, DM-03), Contract-defines-everything (DM-07, DM-10, DM-11), Events plus credit/rebill (DM-17, DM-18, DM-24) and the internal ledger with fee/payable changes (DM-22, DM-26). Two of these (Contract model, intake matching) sit on items still at Verify or Proposed, so build thin.

### Themes

1. **Slot, List and Draft List (EP-01; DM-02, DM-03, DM-04, DM-05, DM-42; RV-14, RV-15, RV-30). XL.** Slot and List are one welded record; availability is a six-value code enum; cover is a request marker nobody resolves. dataModelDeltas.title: Slot, List and Draft List are separate things: the prototype welds Slot and List together
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Settled logical model (OQ-64): a day holds an AM and a PM Slot for every active anaesthetist. Every Slot is created and stored across a rolling horizon (four months in current practice, a rarely changed setting; shortening drops days, extending fills them), empty ones included, free by default, from the anaesthetist's start date, freely editable afterwards. A Slot is a box with a status; a List is put into it and shows in place of the status. A List sits in exactly one Slot and, once assigned, has one anaesthetist, one surgeon, one hospital, one day and one session; a Slot with no List has no surgeon or hospital. A recurring booking creates its List before any Bookings exist. A reassignment consumes the covering anaesthetist's Slot; what the vacated Slot shows is open (OQ-84). Storage is for the developers; the word 'slot' never appears in the UI.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Only List exists (types.ts:301): one per anaesthetist x date x session, id derived from the slot (listIdForSlot, domain/seed/canvas.ts:45). An empty Slot is a List with statusKey 'free' and state 'DRAFT' (canvas.ts:103-110); assigning a surgeon and hospital edits the same record. reassignList deletes the target's free List and mints a new id for the vacated slot (lifecycle.ts:543-626), so List and Slot identity are welded. No Day entity (DayNote per date only, types.ts:635), no Anaesthetist start date (types.ts:141-151). Horizon is a constant, 14 days back to 4 months forward (clock.ts:86-104). Default AM and PM times are hard-coded by status (canvas.ts:50-58). A List with no Bookings already exists (a PermanentList paints hospital and surgeon, canvas.ts:119-124).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Foundation and largest structural change on the schedule side; must precede DM-03, DM-04, DM-05, DM-06 and DM-42. Introduce a Slot record (anaesthetist, date, session, status, optional time override) on the deterministic slot id, and give List its own id plus a slotId set on assignment. Keeping every Slot stored (about 20,000 small records, which the seed already generates) is the cheapest reading. A Day entity is not needed: the date is the key. Make the horizon length a stored setting and give the anaesthetist a start date (DM-33). Ripples into seed canvas generation, daily roll-forward (US-01.1.2), listForSlot and bookingsForList selectors, reassignList, the Admin Day grid, mobile schedule and web availability. PERSIST_VERSION bump and reseed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Draft List: a List created with no anaesthetist, which can hold Bookings
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Draft List is a List created with no anaesthetist. Hospital, surgeon, day and session are all required, and it takes no Slot. Bookings can be added before assignment. It arises when a surgeon's room needs an anaesthetist and none is assigned, when an anaesthetist moves a List to the office (including by marking its Slot unavailable, US-01.5.5), when a recurring booking lands on a Slot the anaesthetist already marked unavailable (the calendar is painted first, OQ-81 parts 1 and 2), and (Future Work) an automated reschedule clash. Shown prominently in the Admin App, flagged as unassigned, sorted by date with time waiting. Never offered to anaesthetists (OQ-86 asks Ben). Only an admin assigns it, choosing only the anaesthetist; it becomes a List in the predefined Slot keeping everything recorded, with a soft warning for an unavailable Slot or a blacklisted pairing. An unfilled one is removed or re-dated, audited. A matching-screen row can create one (US-02.1.2).

Generation paints availability before the PermanentList (canvas.ts:116-119) but silently drops the recurring booking on an unavailable Slot instead of creating a Draft List. setAvailability flags a conflict on a booked List (lifecycle.ts:737-748) instead of offering return-or-assign.

dataModelDeltas.title: Availability is a status on the Slot, kept up from one calendar (with series), with the status values held as editable master data
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Availability is a status held on the half-day Slot, free by default; AM and PM can differ. The anaesthetist keeps it up from a calendar in their app (mark days off, create a series, edit or delete one instance); Slot status and calendar are one mechanism, and a List shows in place of the status. Status values are master data: fixed internal ID, editable label and colour, rules read the ID, new status with no code change (US-01.2.2); starting values free (default), on holiday, unavailable, to be defined with AA's users. Marking a Slot unavailable while it holds a List asks the anaesthetist to return it to the office (Draft List) or assign it to a colleague (US-01.5.5). Admins set default AM and PM times, overridable per Slot (US-01.1.4). Short-notice sickness is open (OQ-81 part 3). The catalogue models no List 'kind'; private, public and pre-op are only candidate statuses (US-01.2.1).

A six-value ListStatusKey on the List (private, public, preop, holiday, unavailable, free; types.ts:53-61) mixes what is booked with availability and is locked to the theme palette by statusKeyParity.test.ts. dataModelDeltas.title: An anaesthetist moves their own List with no request and no office confirmation (replaces the cover request)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An anaesthetist selects one of their Lists and either moves it to the AA office, where it becomes a Draft List, or pushes it into a free Slot of a colleague found in the availability view. The colleague does not accept and the office does not confirm: a high-trust system. Withdrawing from a List also returns it as a Draft List. A blacklisted pairing shows the same soft warning as an office assignment. The office is notified through the Admin App's shared notification pool and offered the cover-change update email; the colleague sees the List appear with a notice (OQ-65). The Slot left behind is open (OQ-84). The office can still reassign a List with its Bookings (owner reference changes, one temporal event from, to, by, when).

dataModelDeltas.title: Whoever submits a List did its procedures: a Booking done by someone else moves to their List, and its payable follows
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The List's anaesthetist did every procedure on it. If another anaesthetist does a Booking, it is moved to a List of theirs (before the procedure), even a one-Booking List; an anaesthetist never does a procedure on another's List. The payable, and any prepayment payee, follow the Booking; prepayments are re-checked on any move, the agreed prepaid amount stays, the doer is paid and wears or benefits from the rate difference, and only the payable half of the prepayment's draft pair is updated (OQ-70; timing OQ-80). Say 'completed or submitted Booking', never 'timesheet'.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: reassignBooking (lifecycle.ts:635-684) lets an anaesthetist move a Booking only between their own DRAFT Lists (refuse 'notOwnList'); only the office can move a Booking to another anaesthetist's List, and the move neither creates a List for the doer nor re-checks prepayment. The payee is never stored: anaesthetistIdForCase joins case, Booking, List and anaesthetist live (selectors.ts:611), while BillingReceipt stamps anaesthetistId at receipt (types.ts:752-762) and XeroAccPay carries no anaesthetist id (types.ts:790-807).

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract is reshaped from Type 1/2/3 to category, holder, multi-dimension scope, pricing basis, aaCode and payment setting
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One reusable Contract answers how a Procedure is priced, what rules apply, who is invoiced (it always defines the billable party, OQ-67) and what extra Booking inputs are needed. Fields: id, aaCode (short structured, searchable, format open OQ-66), name, version, effective-from and -to, reviewDate; category (RVG Default Post-paid, RVG Default Hospital, Hospital, Surgeon Solo, Surgeon Group, Insurance; no Pre-paid category); holder (hospital, surgeon or group, insurer, or the payer named when picked); scope filters on hospitals, procedures, surgeons, insurers, RVG codes or groups, funding source and specific anaesthetists (empty means organisational, which merges the retired individual-Contract story); pricing basis (anaesthetist's own unit value, contract rate or discount, fixed fee schedule, Contract defined unit rate); baseUnitOverrides; multiProcedureRule; allowsAnaesthetistAdjustment; paymentSetting FULL or SPLIT; requiredBookingInputs; invoice layout, delivery method, GST treatment. A combination is a Contract set against each parent procedure. Greg is not on board with the model (US-04.1.1 Verify) and OQ-78 is open. domain-model.md still lists 'RVG Default Pre-paid'; US-04.1.1 and OQ-25 win.

The selectContract precedence resolver becomes scope filtering plus an explicit choice (DM-10). fee.ts, contracts.ts, contractActions.ts, the MasterData Contract editor and seed contracts all change. scope.anaesthetists becomes a list; SurgeonGroup with members (DM-32); a simple sequence for aaCode until OQ-66. Keep the field set flexible while Greg reviews the model. DM-08, 09, 10, 14, 15, 16, 27, 28, 43 and 46 depend on it.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.1.1, 04.1.4, 04.2.1, 04.2.2, 04.2.8 re-read; fields match. Added the Verify-status caveat on the model.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract versions and the AUTHORISED snapshot (Contract and calculation inputs locked with the Procedure)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every version of a Contract is kept. At AUTHORISED the engine snapshots the Contract version onto each Procedure, plus the reference data the calculation used (rates, RVG values, the anaesthetist's unit value, party details), so an invoice as raised can be produced again and later edits never alter it. The engine reads the locked Contract only. Every price line carries its own effective-from date; which date decides is open (OQ-48).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No version on Contract and no snapshot: authoriseList only flips state (lifecycle.ts:262-292). The billing run rates against the LIVE contract and writes amounts into InvoiceLine description text. If the stored Contract has expired by billing, resolveContractForProcedure falls back to the holder's default Type 1 or raises a failed case (invoiceBuild.ts:114-150, 'contractIneffective'). Contract has one effectiveFrom and effectiveTo pair; ContractPrice has no dates.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Append-only Contract version history (contractId + version) and a per-Procedure locked record (contractId, version, unit value, base units, price line) written in authoriseList; the billing run reads only that record, which removes the effective-date fallback branch and its 'contractIneffective' failure demo. The same record fixes the payee anaesthetist (DM-06). Depends on DM-07 and DM-09. Reseed and PERSIST_VERSION bump. Exact frozen fields still to decide (US-15.0.3).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.1.3, 04.3.5, 07.3.1 re-read; invoiceBuild contractIneffective branch confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: ContractPrice becomes a full FeeScheduleLine chosen on the Procedure
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Children of a fixed-fee Contract: the holder's code and description, price excluding and including GST, optional mapped RVG codes so BTM is still recorded, optional time band, an add-on flag and a quantity rule, plus tier and effective-from per line (domain model; US-04.2.10 for the date). The Procedure records which line applies; base, time and modifier units are still recorded when the price comes from a line. Holder codes are searchable references. How time bands, add-ons and quantity rules combine with 'the fixed fee is the total price' is OQ-89.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ContractPrice (types.ts:250-258): contractId, optional rvgBaseCode, surgeonId, procedureOrdinal, price; matched most-specific-wins by key (matchContractPrice, contracts.ts:77-). No holder code, description, GST-inclusive price, time band, add-on, quantity rule, tier or date. No feeScheduleLineId on Procedure; a Type 3 with no matching row falls back to BTM (fee.ts:199-228, a labelled demo reading).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace ContractPrice and key-based matching with an explicit line chosen on the Procedure and shown by holder code. fee.ts's Type 3 branch gains time bands, add-ons and quantity (combination rule switchable until OQ-89); procedureOrdinal moves to the Contract's multiProcedureRule (DM-15). Seed needs realistic lines; the Admin price editor changes. Depends on DM-07. The not-on-schedule outcome is DM-16.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.2.4 and 04.2.10 re-read; fee.ts Type 3 branch re-read. Tier is domain-model only, not in the story body.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure selects exactly one Contract, picked procedure first, narrowed by the List's hospital; the billing-route step disappears
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: No route step. Every Procedure has exactly one Contract before its Booking can be completed. Admin sets it at booking setup; the anaesthetist may change it until they submit (US-03.4.1, Confirmed); the office approves or corrects it at SUBMITTED review. The user picks the procedure first (master procedure list grouped by RVG body headings), then a Contract from those set against it, narrowed by the List's hospital (and possibly the surgeon, not settled); the default RVG Contract is always offered; typing an AA code or holder code filters to that Contract. Insurer or funding source is NOT a filter (OQ-55). Where nothing more specific applies the Procedure defaults to the RVG Default Hospital Contract of the List's hospital. A combination Contract is chosen once and the Booking records only the Contract. Thousands of Contracts must stay navigable (OQ-66).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure has billingRoute ('hospital' | 'billableParty' | 'insurer'), governingContractId (optional), insurerId, billablePartyId, patientPaymentCategory, prepaymentDetail and billingReference (types.ts:462-488). The validator fails an unset route (validateBookingForBilling.ts:124-127); the billing run resolves contract and payer from route plus stored contract (invoiceBuild.ts:114-215); the 'billableParty' route needs no contract. Contract choice is an unfiltered select of every Contract in the office-only billing-setup sheet (EditBillingSetupSheet.tsx:176). The route is also set by the anaesthetist at ad hoc entry (ManualBookingForm.tsx:67) and in EditProcedureSheet. No procedure-first picker, no hospital-narrowed list, no code search. Default Contracts for a new hospital or insurer are already auto-created (mastersActions.ts:45-150).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Removes BillingRoute, PatientPaymentCategory and the route-driven use of Procedure.insurerId (DM-12); governingContractId becomes required for completion. Who gets the invoice comes from the Contract (DM-11); the prepayment trigger moves to the anaesthetist's prepaid settings (DM-19, DM-20). Rewrites resolveContractForProcedure, counterpartyForProcedure, validateBookingForBilling, the mobile and web capture, the office billing-setup UI (route picker becomes a filtered Contract picker for admin and anaesthetist), review flags and the seed for every Booking. New: filtered picker selector with AA-code and holder-code search, and defaulting the Procedure to the List's hospital default at setup. Default-Contract auto-creation already exists; it only becomes the RVG Default Hospital / Insurance category. Depends on DM-07, DM-13 and DM-43; DM-11 runs alongside. Largest ripple on the billing side.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft listed default-Contract auto-creation for a new hospital or insurer as new work; createHospital and createInsurer already do it (mastersActions.ts:45-150). Rest holds.

dataModelDeltas.title: Billable party and invoice email are defined by the Contract, with no per-Booking override; the guardian record goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure's Contract defines who pays and where the invoice goes, with as many Contracts as AA needs. Picking a default (or patient-direct) Contract asks for the name and email of whoever pays, for example a guardian, so even a default Contract has a billable party; a hospital taking the invoice is a Contract with that hospital as billable party. The billable party is independent of how the Procedure is priced. No separate guardian record: a guardian's details are a Contract-level matter kept for the life of the debt, then archived. A patient under 18 as billable party is a mild clearable warning (DM-31). The Contract declares which inputs are required and the Booking holds the entered values (US-04.2.7). Invoices go to the invoice email captured on the Booking (US-08.4.2). OQ-78 open. EP-11's opening paragraphs still say each Booking carries its own billable party; FT-11.2, US-11.2.2, US-08.2.1 and the domain model say otherwise and win.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillableParty (types.ts:127-134) is a guardian-only master record with its own Xero contact type. The payer is derived per Procedure: counterpartyForProcedure returns the insurer, the BillableParty or the patient on the route, else the resolved contract's holder (invoiceBuild.ts:192-215), stored nowhere. A per-Procedure billablePartyId override exists (types.ts:475), chosen in EditBillingSetupSheet.tsx:154. No invoice email on Booking, Procedure or Invoice (only Patient.email and BillableParty.email). No under-18 check (Patient.dobISO exists, types.ts:107). CounterpartyRef already covers hospital, insurer, surgeon, organisation, patient and billableParty (types.ts:73-83).
dataModelDeltas.impact: REVERSES the earlier plan (Booking-level payer defaulting from the Contract holder with an override). Replace the per-Procedure billablePartyId override and the guardian master with payer details captured when a default or patient-direct Contract is picked: a payer name and email stored with the Procedure's Contract selection, and an invoiceEmail beside it, defaults from the Contract holder. Retire BillableParty as a master and its Xero contact kind, or keep the type as the payer record behind the Contract pick. The billing run keeps grouping by each Procedure's resolved party (DM-28, DM-27). Invoice email required for patient-direct Contracts (US-11.2.3, DM-16). Under-18 check is a warning rule (DM-31). Depends on DM-07 and DM-10. Flag the EP-11 wording to the owner.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-11.2.1 to 11.2.4, US-08.4.2 re-read; code anchors hold.

dataModelDeltas.title: Insurer and funding source belong to neither Patient nor Booking
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: OQ-55: insurer and funding source are held on neither the Patient nor the Booking; each Procedure's Contract says who pays. Funding source (private, SXAP, HNZ, ACC) describes the Contract and is no longer a picker filter. An insurer that does not accept direct claims means the patient is invoiced and forwards it (US-11.4.2). ACC is a Hospital or holder Contract with ACC pricing, invisible to the engine (US-05.5.1).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.insurerId (types.ts:469), payer only on the 'insurer' route and informational on the hospital route, and Procedure.accRelated (types.ts:486), an informational boolean whose only consumer is the 'ACC should not bill the patient directly' review advisory, which fires on the billableParty route (reviewFlags.ts:83). Insurer master has acceptsDirectClaims (types.ts:166-174). No funding-source value anywhere.
